overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet to consider the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget draft, review a preliminary plat for Green Tree Subdivision, and address collective bargaining negotiations with the police association. The meeting also included routine financial reporting and administrative updates.

agenda.item: Finance Director/Treasurer - 7/31/2026 Financial Statements (Budget Status Report)
Update on TID #1 Information from 2026 Equalized Valuation Report - Email Response from Wisconsin Department of Revenue
July 2026 Check Register, ACH Register, and Credit Card Transactions Activity
2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget - 1st Draft as of 7/31/2026
Closed Session - Negotiating collective bargaining agreement for Kronenwetter Professional Police Association

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to review the village's budget status report and financial statements as of July 31, 2026. This routine financial reporting was set to provide an overview of the village's fiscal position through the end of July.

discussions.item: Update on TID #1 Information from 2026 Equalized Valuation Report
discussions.body: The board was expected to consider information regarding Tax Increment District #1 from the 2026 equalized valuation report, including an email response from the Wisconsin Department of Revenue. This item was scheduled to update the board on the district's valuation status.

The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the first draft of the ten-year Capital Improvements Program budget as of July 31, 2026. This item was set for initial review of the village's planned infrastructure and capital projects for the coming decade.
The board was expected to consider and take possible action on the preliminary plat for Green Tree Subdivision. This item was scheduled for development review of the proposed subdivision project.

discussions.item: Collective Bargaining Agreement Negotiation - Kronenwetter Professional Police Association
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to convene in closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(e) to negotiate the collective bargaining agreement with the Kronenwetter Professional Police Association. This closed session was set to address compensation and employment terms for the police association.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, with possible time extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
